scope: Android field-scenario long-answer model comparison implementation and APK/code validation; no device or native generation execution

comparisonSettings.npuFallbackReason: The current application NPU context limit is 1280, below the requested 2048 output budget; portable GPU/CPU fallback is recorded.

features: Complex fictional field scenarios covering gas readings, sampling, ventilation, respiratory protection, rescue equipment, hot work, inert gases, CO, rescue, CPR, handover and measurement reliability
Three evidence subqueries per case, preserving different selected conditions from the same source page
Detailed Korean Markdown instructions with procedures, comparison tables and checklists
Completed-prefix live answer preview and partial text capture on recoverable exceptions
First completed-text latency, total generation time, engine preparation, actual backend and output character count
Human review checklist and incomplete evidence subquery reporting
Nullable native token statistics and output-limit status when unsupported by the SDK
Large JSON file sharing through a restricted cache FileProvider
Legacy quick-v1 reports retain their original five-question, 256-token conditions

newRegressionTests: Detailed scenarios retain manual 2048-token output instead of automatic brief output
Different selected conditions from the same source page survive subquery merge
Legacy reports preserve original settings and identity
Long raw and formatted text, review metadata and unknown termination survive JSON round-trip

limitations: Output length and completion depend on each model and the available context; an output cap is not a guaranteed answer length.
Actual common-evidence retrieval, long generation, screen rendering, export interaction, memory use and thermal behavior require device validation.
Automated regressions do not establish field-answer correctness, native model compatibility or speed.
A forced process exit may lose the in-progress answer; only previously saved completed rows are restored.
